pages.text: A Rivertear is an Arcane Gem formed from a blue-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in a pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, a Rivertear will conjure a block of water at a distance of up to 40 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.$(br2)To recharge a dun Rivertear, toss it in a block of water.

When placed in a Lightwell with access to the sky, a Rivertear generates water at an extremely rapid rate. While it's possible for a Rivertear to shatter, the chances of shattering are astronomically unlikely. For all intents and purposes, a Rivertear lasts indefinitely unless its Lightwell is broken. Once placed in a Lightwell, a Rivertear cannot be retrieved.
pages.title: Astral Sorcery Lightwell

pages.text: If you have a Rivertear somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:items/gem_socket)Gem Socket$()), right clicking on a Petal Apothecary will refill it with water.
pages.title: Botania Petal Apothecary

pages.text: If you have a Rivertear somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:items/gem_socket)Gem Socket$()), right clicking on a Crucible will refill it with water.
pages.title: Thaumcraft Crucible
